results.title: Financing Europe's defence build-up: National budgets and beyond | European Union Institute for Security Studies
results.snippet:
Raising ‘core’ defence spending to 3.5% of GDP would mean increasing annual spending to around €658 billion. That means Europeans will need to find an additional €204 billion a year (in today’s money) by 2035. This will put public finances across most of Europe under strain.
